partners.mechanism_chain: USP9X (HGNC:12709) —DISRUPTS→ Ubiquitin-mediated protein degradation (GO:0000422); Ubiquitin-mediated protein degradation (GO:0000422) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); MAPK1 (HGNC:6871) —INCREASES→ RAS-MAPK signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-70275); RAS-MAPK signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-70275) —LEADS_TO→ Short stature (HP:0004325); RAS-MAPK signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-70275) —LEADS_TO→ Pulmonary valve stenosis (HP:0001653); RAS-MAPK signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-70275) —LEADS_TO→ Facial dysmorphism (HP:0001999); Ubiquitin-mediated protein degradation (GO:0000422) —INCREASES→ RAS-MAPK signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-70275). Loss-of-function in USP9X disrupts ubiquitin-mediated protein degradation, impacting neuronal development and leading to intellectual disability. Gain-of-function in MAPK1 hyperactivates the RAS-MAPK signaling pathway, contributing to the syndromic features of Noonan syndrome 13 including short stature, pulmonary valve stenosis, and facial dysmorphism. partners.mechanism_chain: USP9X (HGNC:23423) —DISRUPTS→ Ubiquitin-mediated protein degradation (GO:0006511); Ubiquitin-mediated protein degradation (GO:0006511) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability, syndromic, female-restricted (MONDO:0010502); STAT1 (HGNC:11301) —DISRUPTS→ Interferon signaling pathway (GO:0060337); Interferon signaling pathway (GO:0060337) —DECREASES→ Immune response to intracellular pathogens (GO:0002702); Immune response to intracellular pathogens (GO:0002702) —LEADS_TO→ Mendelian susceptibility to mycobacterial diseases (MONDO:0013956); Ubiquitin-mediated protein degradation (GO:0006511) —DECREASES→ Immune response to intracellular pathogens (GO:0002702). Loss-of-function variants in STAT1 (Disease B) directly impair the interferon signaling pathway, which is critical for the immune response to intracellular pathogens like mycobacteria. The convergence occurs at the level of the 'Immune response to intracellular pathogens' pathway (n7), as impaired protein degradation (n2) can also compromise the cell's ability to effectively manage intracellular infections, thus linking the two disease modules.
